message: depcurfew cannot tell which Composer runs this project (Composer has no setting that pins its version), and Composer older than 2.11.0 ignores config.policy.cooldown.period and config.policy.cooldown.ignore (added in 2.11.0) without a word
fix: Use Composer 2.11.0 or later wherever composer update or composer require runs (composer self-update), CI and Dockerfiles included
